insights.title: Delivery Delay Sentiment Impact
insights.message: On-time deliveries average 4.29 stars, whereas late deliveries drop to 2.57 stars (-1.73 star penalty). Keeping delays under 5% is the primary lever to boost CSAT.

insights.title: Customer Retention Opportunity
insights.message: Current repeat customer rate is 3.12%. 96.88% of buyers purchase only once. Implementing post-purchase engagement and replenishment reminders represents a major revenue expansion opportunity.

insights.title: Category Leadership
insights.message: 'Health Beauty' is the highest revenue contributor at R$ 1,258,681.34 (9.3% of total platform GMV), followed closely by Watches & Gifts.

insights.title: Geographic Demand Concentration
insights.message: São Paulo (SP) represents 42.0% of total order volume (41,746 orders), driving rapid average delivery times of 8.3 days compared to the national average of 12.5 days.
